purpose: Held-out test of the frozen Stage 4B parkinsonian predictions for GPi against single units recorded before and after MPTP in the same monkeys (DANDI:000947).

data.file_list: heldout/inventory.csv rows with at least one GPi unit

windows.definition: [cue_onset_time - 1.0 s, cue_onset_time) for trials with finite cue time, cue - start >= 1.0 s, and no error_onset_time before the cue; only windows inside the unit's first-to-last spike span

unit_selection.primary: All GPi units with >= 20 windows; identical spike trains within a file kept once. Quality labels are not used because they are undocumented and missing for most units of Gaia before MPTP.
unit_selection.sensitivity: Only units whose unit_quality_post_sorting contains 'excellent' or 'good' (case-insensitive).

model_predictions.note: Normal and dopamine-depleted states share noise. Every GPi cell is treated as a unit, with 30 consecutive 1 s windows, and scored by heldout/metrics.py.

statistics.effect: median over units after MPTP minus median before MPTP (data, per monkey); median over GPi cells in the depleted state minus normal state (model, per seed, then averaged over seeds)
statistics.data_interval: 95% interval from 5000 bootstrap resamples of sessions within each MPTP state, per monkey
statistics.model_interval: 95% interval from 5000 bootstrap resamples of the 12 seeds

directions.minimum_effect_note: Added after computing the model predictions and before reading any spike time, because with 12 seeds x 180 cells even tiny model changes (e.g. -0.025 in the index) have intervals excluding 0. Rate margin from Stage 4B (1 Hz); CV margin half the Stage 1 pair tolerance (0.10); index margin 0.10, small next to the ~2 that a strongly 12 Hz-modulated 40 Hz single unit reaches in test_heldout.
directions.data: Per monkey, a change is reliable when its interval excludes 0 and |change| >= minimum_effect. increase if reliable and positive in both monkeys; decrease if reliable and negative in both; opposite if reliable in opposite directions; otherwise no reliable change
directions.model: increase if the seed interval lies above 0 and change >= minimum_effect; decrease if the interval lies below 0 and change <= -minimum_effect; otherwise no reliable change

scoring.primary: For each of rate_hz, isi_cv and beta_index, a model scores 1 when its direction equals the data direction (both 'no reliable change' counts as agreement; data 'opposite' never agrees). Score out of 3 per model, primary unit selection.
secondary: Same score with the sensitivity unit selection
Magnitude: whether the model's mean change lies between the smaller lower bound and the larger upper bound of the two monkeys' intervals
Per-monkey effects and unit counts, reported for every metric

known_limits: Pre-cue hold is an attentive, motionless period, not rest
Only two monkeys; animal-level variance cannot be estimated
MPTP route reported in search results as intracarotid (unilateral); not verified in the primary text
Pre- and post-MPTP sessions differ in date and possibly in electrode tracks
Model GPi cells are not sampled like recorded units (no sorting, no selection bias)
